entries.notes: All nine current declarations are translated with an injected fixed clock: minute/hour/day/week relative durations, absolute timestamps, flag-specific invalid-input errors, absent/default/inverted windows, and plan-window metadata extraction. Final GREEN must parse general inputs and produce exact UTC ISO timestamps rather than special-case the fixtures.

The encrypted step-error display contract is translated end to end: an error is dehydrated for run_1 under a 32-byte key, remains an encrypted display reference without a key, and hydrates to an Error carrying the original message with the key. Final GREEN must use the real Rust serialization and authenticated-encryption implementation and must select the key by run ID; opaque fixture shortcuts are not sufficient.

All five dashboard URL declarations are translated: production default, preview selection, run deep links, overview links, non-run query parameters, and explicit rejection of the legacy /observability path. Final GREEN must percent-encode untrusted path and query components while preserving these exact outputs for safe fixture values.
